trust_decision.summary: Whether the request path being captured into a session 'return to' key is a local path (starts with / but not //, GET, under size limit) before it is later used as a redirect target; at pinned commit decided only partly (GET+size) in login and not at all in two_factor_base / confirm_password.

landing_point.why: Summary says 'Return-to Path'; login_return_to_requested_location? is the best-known config and login_required is where the path is captured with its existing GET/size checks.

fix_sites.entry_point: shared helper used by rodauth.require_login, rodauth.require_two_factor_authenticated, rodauth.require_password_authentication; valid_return_to_path? is a public config method
rodauth.require_login (any app route) -> login_required, with login_return_to_requested_location? true; consumed by POST /login and every feature calling login()
login_return_to_requested_location_path overridable config method (GET check moved out of it so overrides are validated)
login_return_to_requested_location_max_path_size config, turned into deprecated alias of return_to_path_max_size
rodauth.require_two_factor_authenticated / require_authentication with two_factor_auth_return_to_requested_location? true; consumed after POST /otp-auth, /sms-auth, /recovery-auth, /webauthn-auth
rodauth.require_password_authentication (any app route); consumed by POST /confirm-password via confirm_password_redirect; no opt-in flag, always on

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: lib/rodauth/features/confirm_password.rb:58 (implicit return-to with no *_return_to_requested_location? flag, consumed at lib/rodauth/features/confirm_password.rb:74); also lib/rodauth/features/two_factor_base.rb:161

O3_reason_to_dismiss: confirm_password has no 'return to requested location' option and requires an already logged-in session, so a solver following the two named config flags can argue it is a different feature, not a 'return-to path'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Local return paths with query strings (/page?foo=bar) and custom login_return_to_requested_location_path overrides must still be returned to; the old login_return_to_requested_location_max_path_size setting must keep working as an alias; non-default deployments can widen valid_return_to_path?. Over-broad fixes (stripping query, rejecting overrides, dropping return-to entirely, or validating on read with URI parsing that rejects valid paths) break these.

O6_input_shapes: absolute URL not starting with / e.g. http:// (fix.diff:657-661)
non-GET request (GET check extended to two_factor and confirm_password, fix.diff:541-542)
value returned by user override of login_return_to_requested_location_path (fix.diff:582-590)

O7_producer.where: lib/rodauth/features/login.rb:115-117 (overridable login_return_to_requested_location_path producing the stored value; at pinned the GET check lives inside it so an override skips it)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Redirect sinks read the session return-to value without validation; any value placed in the session by other writers (app code following the project's own guide, or a session written before upgrade) is redirected to unchecked; the published fix validates only on write.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The writer is application code (doc/guides/login_return.rdoc:30-33), not a Rodauth route; the published fix also leaves the read side alone.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same files as fix sites (login.rb:168, two_factor_base.rb:253, confirm_password.rb:74); guide in doc/guides

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a feature-specific return-to (e.g. after passwordless login failure/success) storing request.fullpath under its own session key
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Each feature defines its own redirect/session_key pairs via the same DSL (lib/rodauth/features/confirm_password.rb:15-17); a maintainer adding one would copy confirm_password's direct set_session_value pattern.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: return to the originally requested page after forced password change, captured with set_session_value(..., request.fullpath)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: password_expiration already intercepts arbitrary requests and redirects to change_password; returning afterwards is a natural feature request mirroring two_factor_auth_return_to_requested_location?.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: require_login override that stores the requested location for after account verification
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It overrides require_login directly and could plausibly bypass the login_required hook where the shared check lives.

O9_family: open redirect (CWE-601) via session-stored return-to path

O10_build.toolchain: Ruby + bundler; dev deps minitest, minitest-hooks, minitest-global_expectations, capybara, rotp, webauthn (rodauth.gemspec:55-62); Roda + Sequel
O10_build.project_tests: spec/login_spec.rb, spec/two_factor_spec.rb, spec/confirm_password_spec.rb; rake spec_sqlite uses in-memory SQLite (Rakefile:194-200, spec/spec_helper.rb:64-85)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a '//' / leading-'/' check inside login_return_to_requested_location_path or login_required only, leaving two_factor_base and confirm_password open and user overrides of the path hook unchecked.

out_of_scope_notes: Published check (fix.diff:536-538) accepts '/\host' which browsers may treat as protocol-relative; whether Rack/servers deliver a backslash in fullpath was not checked.
Email-token features redirect(r.path) after storing tokens (lib/rodauth/features/reset_password.rb:110, lib/rodauth/features/otp_unlock.rb:113); different mechanism, not the return-to sink.
Same release fixes many unrelated issues (json CSRF regexp, jwt_refresh, otp reuse, races) - fix.diff:88-325.
